design_persona: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer (High-End PropTech Luxury & Trust)

rules: Strict compliance with palette: warm ivory #F6F1E7, deep charcoal #111111, refined gold #B8894A
No full-screen heavy gradients or saturated tech blues/purples
Gradients are strictly limited to subtle gold radial glows behind countdown numerals and confetti overlays
Dark surfaces (e.g. countdown or celebration active state card) must use deep charcoal #111111 with ivory text

headings.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight text-[#111111] leading-[1.15]
headings.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal text-[#111111]
headings.subheading: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-light text-[#444444] tracking-wide

body.small_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#B8894A] font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 sm:px-12 py-12 lg:py-20
layout_and_spacing.whitespace: Generous vertical spacing (p-8 to py-24) to convey trust, calm, and elegance
layout_and_spacing.header_nav: Clean floating or top-aligned header with LOKAGER wordmark and subtle 'India' trust indicator. Non-distracting.
layout_and_spacing.ceremony_card: Centered focus stage with crisp 1px borders (border-[#111111]/10 or gold glow border), rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl, deep ivory/charcoal contrast.

state_1_launch_screen.description: Initial state. Shows LOKAGER wordmark, tagline 'Where Property Meets Trust', and the LAUNCH LOKAGER button.

button_design.size: min-h-[72px] px-10 py-5 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-serif tracking-wider
button_design.styling: bg-[#111111] text-[#F6F1E7] border-2 border-[#B8894A] rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:bg-[#B8894A] hover:text-[#111111] transition-all duration-300 transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-4 w-full sm:w-auto mx-auto
button_design.reliability_focus: One-tap trigger with instant visual and audio/haptic cue. Founder's mother friendly (large touch target, zero delay).

state_2_countdown_screen.numerals: Massive serif numerals (e.g. text-7xl sm:text-9xl) in gold #B8894A with tabular numbers layout so text doesn't shift.
state_2_countdown_screen.visuals: SVG circular radial progress ring or sleek linear progress bar filling from 0 to 100%. Subtle glowing aura.

state_3_celebration_screen.heading: CONGRATULATIONS! LOKAGER IS NOW LIVE
state_3_celebration_screen.effects: Gold confetti explosion using canvas-confetti with custom palette (#B8894A, #D4AF37, #F3E5AB, #111111). Gold shimmer burst.

state_4_coming_soon_screen.heading: LOKAGER IS NOW LIVE
state_4_coming_soon_screen.trust_statement: Building a more trusted property experience.
state_4_coming_soon_screen.offerings_styling: Horizontal/vertical pill wrap in refined charcoal text, gold dot separators, clean minimalist aesthetics.
state_4_coming_soon_screen.footer: Minimal footer with copyright, 'Built for India', and subtle restart ceremony option for testing/demo.

page_404.headline: 404 — Property Not Found
page_404.subtext: The page or property you are looking for has been moved or does not exist.

motion_and_effects.principles: Subtle, dignified, non-gimmicky. Smooth opacity fades, gentle scale-ups, no jitter.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both / and /launch routes load the ceremony application cleanly.
The LAUNCH LOKAGER button must be extremely prominent, highly responsive on touch, with data-testid='launch-button'.
When tapped, transition seamlessly into the 30-second countdown.
Ensure the countdown tick is exact (30s timer) and updates every second smoothly.
When countdown reaches 0, auto-transition to Celebration state with confetti explosion and heading 'CONGRATULATIONS! LOKAGER IS NOW LIVE'.

After 4 seconds of celebration (or smooth transition), reveal the final Coming Soon screen featuring wordmark, tagline ('Where Property Meets Trust'), trust statement ('Building a more trusted property experience.'), vertical/pill list of categories (Buy, Sell, Rent, New Projects, Commercial, Land, Mortgage), and minimal footer.
Provide a subtle reset/re-launch button at the bottom of the final screen to allow easy re-testing of the ceremony.
Build a custom, elegant 404 page matching the warm ivory/charcoal/gold palette with data-testid='back-home-button'.
Strictly follow the user's constraints: no forms, no fake numbers, no fake testimonials, no cartoon icons, no heavy gradient overloads.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements.
